description: Search PPT Depot's catalog of consulting-grade PowerPoint template decks by keyword (name, headline, description, and the titles and tags of the slides inside each deck). Optional category filter. Returns relevance-ranked templates with page URL, cover image, slide count, and cart URL. Use this first to find a template_id for get_template. For individual slides or frameworks (for example "SWOT matrix" or "issue tree"), use search_slides.

category.description: Optional: restrict to one template category.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "business case", "market entry", "Texas map", "fintech".

name: search_templates
title: Search PPT Templates
